observations: One low resolution photo of a used inline four cylinder petrol engine out of a car, shot from above on a workshop floor.
Silver cam cover with a black oil filler cap, spark plug leads, throttle body and intake hoses attached on top.
Black ribbed timing belt cover at the front, with crank pulley, accessory brackets and a belt visible.
Other engines and parts are piled behind it, so this looks like a used parts dealer's yard.
Surfaces are dusty and grimy, with some discoloured metal; it is clearly a used engine.
No engine code, block stamp or maker's name is readable; a watermark reading 'NWAKONA...LEZE' crosses the timing cover.
No photo of the engine running, of the dipstick or oil, or of the underside and sump.

identity.kind: used inline 4 cylinder petrol car engine (seller says Toyota Camry, code not readable)

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows an inline four cylinder engine whose layout is consistent with an older Camry engine, but no Toyota marking or engine code is readable.
Import history cannot be seen in a photo; no shipping or customs paper shown.
Photo 0 shows a dusty, grimy, discoloured used engine in a parts yard.
Internal history cannot be judged from an outside photo.
No clip of the engine running and no compression readings.
No receipt or warranty document shown; a used imported engine is unlikely to carry an original retail receipt.

risks.risk: Engine code unknown; the make and engine code set the price and the photo does not show them.
risks.proof: Close photo of the engine code stamp on the block and any label on the cam cover or timing cover.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced until the engine code is read

risks.risk: Low compression, knocking, or a blown head gasket.
risks.proof: Clip of the engine test started and idling with sound, plus a compression reading for each cylinder.

risks.risk: Oil contaminated with coolant or sludge inside.
risks.proof: Photo of the dipstick and the underside of the oil filler cap.

risks.risk: Missing or broken sensors, distributor, injectors or wiring harness.
risks.proof: Photos of the engine from all four sides showing what is attached.

risks.risk: Photo may be a dealer's general photo, not the unit sold.
risks.proof: Photo of this engine with a handwritten note of today's date and the seller's name on it.
risks.if_unproven: priced only on the agent's inspection before payment

proof_requests: Close photo of the engine code stamp on the block.
Clip of the engine test started and idling, with sound.
Compression readings for all four cylinders.
Photo of the dipstick and underside of the oil cap.
Photos of the engine from all sides with a handwritten note of today's date.
Photo of the guarantee terms or receipt if it exists.
response.reason: The photo shows a used inline four cylinder engine but no make or engine code is readable, and the engine code sets the price; the seller's 'Toyota Camry' cannot stand in for a reading, so the block stamp is needed before even a worst case price.
